title: A workspace that belongs to you
body: Keep knowledge local and available offline. Private notes and source documents stay on your computer. Portability and simple backups matter more than operating cloud infrastructure.

title: Storage without a server
body: An embedded database holds vertices, relationships and provenance. Vector indexes are derived data and can be rebuilt. A single Rust process should own durable writes.

title: Search should return context
body: Combine keyword matching with vector similarity. Expand related vertices to include decisions and their supporting evidence. Every result should explain how it was found.

title: People and agents share the library
body: Humans write and browse. Agents use MCP to retrieve context and propose links, tags and summaries. Changes should be attributable and reviewable.

title: Similarity is not evidence
body: Two passages can be close in embedding space and disagree. Supporting and contradicting relationships require explicit evidence. Never promote a similarity score into a truth score.

title: Measure the first prototype
body: Compare lexical, vector and hybrid retrieval on realistic questions. Track relevant results, source traceability and missing context. Use a small corpus before optimizing latency.
